titulo: Faulty electrical goods returned to UK supermarkets ending up on Ghana ‘megadump’
cuerpo: Mountains of household items are burned and stripped down at the tip by workers without protection such as masks, investigation alleges Electrical goods that were returned as faulty to leading British stores including Tesco, Argos and Asda have been found dumped on a waste tip in Ghana, an investigation has found. The faulty electrical appliances, including toasters and slow cookers, had been returned to major UK supermarkets. They were found at Agbogbloshie, one of the world’s largest e-waste sites, in Ghana’s capital, Accra, a joint investigation by Unearthed and Greenpeace Africa has found. The findings raise serious questions about e-waste export rules. Continue reading...
